business_problem: Shenzhen Stock Exchange wanted to monitor fast-moving financial public opinion more effectively and use AI to identify capital-market risks earlier instead of relying on slower manual review of broad internet information flows.
solution_summary: Shenzhen Stock Exchange worked with Tencent Cloud to build a financial public-opinion analysis platform for capital-market supervision. The platform ingests large volumes of real-time news and internet opinion data, then applies Tencent Cloud's NLP and knowledge-graph capabilities together with deep-learning event clustering, context analysis, and sentiment analysis. That pipeline deduplicates, classifies, clusters, and analyzes market-related content so staff can quickly isolate negative or sensitive financial signals instead of manually sifting broad information flows. Results are displayed and pushed in personalized ways based on monitoring needs, which lets multiple departments extract daily priority stories, analyze themes, and trigger earlier market-risk warnings. The implementation turns public opinion into a structured regulatory dataset that improves day-to-day efficiency and strengthens the exchange's ability to identify and manage capital-market risk.

solution_components.name: Financial Public Opinion Analysis Platform
solution_components.role: Acts as the user-facing monitoring system for analysis, visualization, and alert delivery.

solution_components.name: NLP Technology
solution_components.role: Extracts meaning from large volumes of financial text so public opinion can be categorized and analyzed.

solution_components.name: Knowledge Graph
solution_components.role: Adds relationship context for entities and events appearing in capital-market public opinion.

solution_components.name: Deep Learning Event Clustering
solution_components.role: Groups related public-opinion events and supports trend and sentiment analysis at scale.

data_flow: Internet public-opinion feeds flow into the analysis platform, where NLP, knowledge-graph processing, event clustering, and sentiment analysis deduplicate and classify content before personalized alerts and dashboards present negative or sensitive market signals to monitoring teams.
business_outcome: The exchange gained a working监管科技 platform that improves daily public-opinion analysis efficiency and gives staff earlier warnings on potential capital-market risk events.
architecture_clues: The platform analyzes all-network real-time public-opinion information.
Deep-learning event clustering, relationship analysis, and sentiment analysis are core algorithms in the stack.
Outputs are personalized and pushed according to monitoring needs.
